name: SSH Pilot
blurb: SSH Pilot is a user-friendly SSH connection manager featuring built-in tabbed terminal, remote file management, key transfer, port forwarding and more.
description:
SSH Pilot is a user-friendly SSH connection manager featuring built-in tabbed terminal, remote file management, key transfer, port forwarding and more. It's an alternative to Putty, Termius and Mobaxterm.

• Manage multiple machines from a unified, clean interface

• Transfer files to and from servers using the built-in file manager (SFTP and SCP)

• Tuned for fast keyboard navigation with customizable shortcuts

• Easily generate and transfer SSH keys to servers

• Loads existing ~/.ssh/config and works with standard SSH keys and settings

• Configure local, remote and dynamic port forwarding

• Server grouping

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
